data.gender_notes: Moumina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'amana' meaning to believe, trust, or place confidence. A faithful believer in Allah, steadfast in their faith. The name Moumina carries the meaning “Faithful believer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moumina usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful believer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strong faith and unwavering trust in Allah.
data.etymology: Moumina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful believer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moumina total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
